title: BBM educational edit
description: An editable starting point for explanation-led editing. Review and adapt before use.
author: Business Based Media
rules: Preserve the meaning, original dialogue and important pauses.
Search approved library assets before proposing new ones. Inspect the actual file; tags alone are not proof of fit.
Prefer demonstrations for processes, evidence for claims, and brief text for key takeaways.
Every 10–15 seconds, assess whether visual variety would help. Do not force a cut on a timer.
Use camera changes and 3D captions when they clarify or emphasize a specific beat.
Flag poor matches, explain why, and propose reuse, adaptation or generation options. Wait for user direction before generating replacements.
Record asset ID, reason, source range, timeline position, duration and requested track in the edit plan. Verify editor MCP capabilities before placing anything.
